title: Aegis - SolEng customer config scratchpad
content:
Customer: Aegis Health (pilot) - private deployment notes and daily to-do

Today (2026-03-13) quick log:
- morning sync w/ infra (Marcus) -> confirmed S3 bucket policies, need bucket encryption check from customer side
- ran smoke inference on dev cluster (g5.48x) -> 95th p50 latency ~ 72ms for short prompts, KV cache warm improves tail by ~18%
- tried quantized variant (int8) on model v1.3 -> small hallucination regressions on long-context samples, flagged for model team

Open action items (prio order):
1) VPC peering checklist - customer network team needs these items by EOD Fri:
   - CIDR overlap confirmation (Aegis Net: 10.12.0.0/16)
   - BGP ASN? -> customer says no BGP, we will do static routes
   - Shared subnets for HA NAT gateways
   - Test plan: ping + curl to private health-check endpoint across peering
   ETA: 2-3 days internal to validate

2) KMS key setup (high priority):
   - They will create a CMK with key policy allowing Redwood IAM role `redwood-deploy-aegis`
   - Our sample terraform snippet for them (send today):
     provider "aws" { region = "us-west-2" }
     resource "aws_kms_key" "aegis_redwood" {
       description = "CMK for Aegis private deployment"
       deletion_window_in_days = 7
     }

3) Model pinning and fallback policy
   - Pin initial rollout to model v1.2-quant-safe (recommended)
   - Fallback chain: v1.2 -> v1.1 -> hosted-small (if private capacity saturated)
   - Need sign-off from product for SLA fallback to hosted; ticket created ENG-1428

Config snippets to drop into their cloud-init / cloudformation (copy/paste candidate):
- inference service config (yaml):
  replicas: 3
  gpu_type: a100-80gb
  batch_policy: "latency_sensitive"
  cache:
    enabled: true
    prefix_kv: 8GB
  model: aegis-llm-v1.2-quant-safe

- routing policy example (json):
  {
    "priority": ["dedicated","hosted"],
    "region_preference": ["us-west-2"],
    "latency_slo_ms": 150
  }

Notes to self / gotchas:
- If customer wants multi-region HA we must coordinate DB replicas (session store) and sticky routing; otherwise KV cache loses locality and latency spikes
- Quantization: int8 gives ~2.6x cost savings but needs prompt-set QA. Prepare 200 prompt regression set and run using Redwood Optimize harness
- Make sure we do not expose admin console to customer VPC subnet without CIDR whitelisting

Questions for product/pm:
- Allowed SLA for failing to meet latency on peak (they want 99th < 250ms). Can we offer credit-style SLA instead of hard fail?
- Do we have a recommended telemetry retention for private customers by default (metrics/traces retention) - default is 7d but Aegis may request 30d (billing implications)

Tomorrow plan (03-14):
- Send KMS terraform snippet + short runbook to Aegis infra (Asha)
- Prepare 200-prompt regression set + run locally against v1.2 and v1.3-quant (Sofia)
- Setup peering test sandbox (Marcus) and validate static route config
- Draft customer-facing checklist for go-live (incl. cutover steps, rollback, smoke tests)

Quick commands and notes I used:
- smoke run: `python infra/tools/smoke_infer.py --model v1.2 --profile aegis-dev` -> logs in /tmp/aegis-smoke.log
- tail logs: `kubectl -n aegis logs -f svc/infer-aegis --since=2h`

End-of-day personal TODO (will update):
- [ ] Send runbook to customer
- [ ] Upload regression set to S3 and attach to ENG-1428
- [ ] Follow up with product on SLA wording

Random thread snippets to paste into customer email later:
"We recommend starting with 3 replicas on A100-80GB, enable prefix KV cache at 8GB, and schedule a weekend cutover window. For encryption, please create a CMK and grant the `redwood-deploy-aegis` role decrypt/encrypt permission."

-- Asha
